name: Commerce Order Data Formatter
description: A field formatter for the Commerce order 'data' field that displays a particular key's value.
project_description:
Overview 

 Provides field formatter for commerce order data field that allows displaying

the value of the particular key in this field.

 Requirements 

 
 Field (Drupal core) 
 Commerce module 
 
 Installation and configuration 

 
 Install and enable the module and all dependencies. 
 On the order view display or views organize the field as your workflow requires.
